segments.name: PLP-USA
segments.description: U.S. operations manufacturing traditional products supporting domestic energy, telecommunications, solar framing and inspection services customers.
segments.evidence: Our PLP-USA segment is comprised of our U.S. operations manufacturing our traditional products primarily supporting our domestic energy, telecommunications, solar framing products and inspection services.

segments.name: The Americas
segments.description: Operations in North and South America, excluding PLP-USA, supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication and solar customers.
segments.evidence: Our other three segments, The Americas, EMEA and Asia-Pacific, support our energy, telecommunications, data communication, solar and other products in each respective geographical region.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication and solar customers.
segments.evidence: We report our segments in four geographic regions: PLP-USA (including corporate), The Americas (includes operations in North and South America, excluding PLP-USA), EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) and Asia-Pacific, in accordance with accounting standards codified in Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 280, "Segment Reporting".

segments.name: Asia-Pacific
segments.description: Operations in the Asia-Pacific region supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication and solar customers.
segments.evidence: Our other three segments, The Americas, EMEA and Asia-Pacific, support our energy, telecommunications, data communication, solar and other products in each respective geographical region.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue by selling cable and wire support, protection and connection products to energy utilities, communication companies, cable operators, governmental agencies, contractors, distributors and value-added resellers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's customers include public and private energy utilities and communication companies, cable operators, governmental agencies, contractors and subcontractors, distributors and value-added resellers.
